name: Hamburg Bit-Bots Wolfgang-OP (20 DoF)
source: bit-bots/wolfgang_robot wolfgang_description/urdf/robot.urdf (b067cae), converted with tools/urdf_to_mjcf.py, MIT
notes: Kid-size robot (~0.8 m) from the RoboCup Humanoid League, an OP-style robot with MX-106/XH-540 servos. Zero pose already has the upper arms down (shoulder roll at its limit) and the forearms forward. No shoulder yaw and no wrist; 'r_wrist' is a fixed frame at the end of the forearm. At zero the knees are hyperextended (the shank tilts 15 deg forward, so the robot leans back on toes-up feet); the rest pose bends them ~16 deg, with ~1.4 deg of hip pitch, for straight vertical legs, which also levels the soles.
